search_text: published ZDI-26-441 ZDI-CAN-29496 dnsmasq DNS Response Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2026-07-15 CVE-2026-2291 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-2291 8.1 AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['dnsmasq'] ['dnsmasq'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of dnsmasq. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of CNAME records. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service. title: dnsmasq DNS Response Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of dnsmasq. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of CNAME records. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service.
